bugs.name: Search syntax help controls do not display any help
bugs.summary: The Search syntax question-mark control has no visible response to click, hover, or keyboard activation. Reproduced in global Search and Products.
bugs.expected: Activating or hovering the Search syntax help control displays syntax guidance or opens the corresponding help.
bugs.actual: Clicking, hovering, and pressing Enter on the focused control leave the page unchanged, with no visible help, tooltip, or dialog. The same behavior was observed in Products.
reproSteps: Sign in and open Search from the sidebar.
Click the question-mark button labeled Search syntax in the search field.
Wait and observe no help appears.
Hover the button, then focus it and press Enter; observe no help appears.
Repeat with the Search syntax control in Catalog → Products to reproduce.
bugs.reason: A genuine pointer hover displays the Search syntax table on both Search and Products, including AND, OR, NOT and exact-phrase examples. Clicking dismisses the hover tooltip; the alleged absence of guidance is false.

reviewedVariants.name: Search syntax control does not display query guidance
reviewedVariants.summary: The Search syntax control shows no syntax guidance after clicking or hovering, even after the results settle.
reviewedVariants.expected: Activating Search syntax should show visible guidance about supported search syntax, including the exclusion operator relevant to `shirt -blue`.
reviewedVariants.actual: The button named Search syntax (shown as a circled question mark) produced no popover, tooltip, or other guidance on click or hover. Repeating the click after results settled and waiting five seconds still showed no guidance; the query and its three results remained unchanged.
reproSteps: Start signed in to the Saleor Dashboard as administrator admin@example.com using the supplied authenticated session.
Enter `shirt -blue` in the Search input and press Enter; allow results to settle.
Click the circled question-mark Search syntax button next to the input, then hover over it. Click it once more after results settle.
Wait five seconds. Confirm no syntax guidance appears and the query/results remain unchanged.
